integrity: Two independently constructed exhaustive standard-library checkers and a complete adjacency certificate are included; no independent scholarly audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification for the Tutte–Coxeter graph only; not a general family theorem. Novelty remains subject to older or unindexed equivalent formulations. Direct full publisher text of the 2025 matching-polynomial article was inaccessible, but its count of 288 is credited as prior.
title: The shortest-cycle perfect-matching flip graph of the Tutte–Coxeter cage
